description: Use this for every playlist change: add media, remove items, reorder, or switch between sequential and shuffle, as one ordered batch. All-or-nothing — if any operation is invalid, nothing is written. A stream that is NOT currently live picks the change up on its next start, with nothing else to call. A stream that IS live keeps playing the arrangement it started with until swap_live_playlist replaces it. Media ids (obj_...) come from list_uploads; item ids (plitm_...) come from get_playlist. Operations apply in sequence, each seeing the result of the previous, so an index in a later operation must account for the earlier ones. Pass basedOnVersion (the `version` from get_playlist) to be told about a concurrent edit instead of overwriting it.

basedOnVersion.description: The playlist `version` from get_playlist this edit was computed against: a CONFLICT refusal if it has changed since. Omitted: the edit applies to the playlist as it is now.

operations.description: Operations in the order they should apply.

items.description: A single operation. Set EXACTLY ONE of addObjects, removeItems, reorderItems, updateSettings — an entry with two of them set is rejected.

index.description: With position INDEX: the 0-based position the first added item takes.

objectIds.description: Media ids (obj_...) to add, in the order they should play.

position.description: Where in the playlist the items go: the start, the end, or the position given in `index`.

removeItems.description: Remove items already in the playlist.

itemIds.description: Playlist item ids (plitm_...) to remove — from get_playlist, NOT media ids.

reorderItems.description: Move items already in the playlist.

moves.description: Ordered moves; each one applies to the result of the previous.

index.description: With position INDEX: the 0-based position the item moves to.

position.description: Where in the playlist the items go: the start, the end, or the position given in `index`.

mode.description: Play order: sequential plays the items as arranged, shuffle randomises each loop. Omitted: the mode is unchanged.

playlistId.description: Playlist id (pl_...) to edit, from list_playlists (for a stream, pass its streamId there).

name: apply_playlist_operations

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it
